notes.title: 🖥️ Multi-Screen Support is Here!
notes.content:
[h1][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45654904/7f034b56fed766f76dbb69da070f21ce5f6cfc37.png"][/img]
Hey fishers![/h1][p]You asked... we listened.
[i]Fishing Corner[/i] now supports [b]multi-monitor setups[/b]![/p][p]You can freely drag the island to [b]any screen[/b] and play from wherever feels most cozy. Whether you're working on one screen and relaxing on the other, your fisherman will be right where you want him.

⚠️ [b]If you run into any issues[/b], let us know in the Discussions tab or drop us a comment here. We’ll do our best to fix it fast!

The Happyland team[/p]
